lines.zh: 我踩过干裂的草地，脚步很沉。
lines.en: I tramp over the cracked grass, heavy-footed.

lines.zh: 两条粗腿往前迈，地皮都发响。
lines.en: Two thick legs stride and the ground complains.

lines.zh: 我在草原上晃着走，谁也别挡。
lines.en: I lumber across the savanna; no one blocks me.

lines.zh: 大肚子一晃一晃，倒走得稳。
lines.en: My big belly sways, yet my gait is steady.

lines.zh: 我在恶地里走，脚底很硌。
lines.en: I walk the badlands and the ground bites my soles.
Slower now; I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 这身肌肉太重，走路都费劲。
lines.en: All this muscle is heavy; even walking tires me.
I climb along the ridge.
Crushing gravel underfoot, I push on.
Two steps and I need a breath.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的树直接撞开。
lines.en: I bulldoze the tree blocking my way.

lines.zh: 走起路来，草都往两边倒。
lines.en: As I walk, the grass falls to either side.

lines.zh: 我站在草原中间，打量四方。
lines.en: I stand mid-savanna and scan all around.

lines.zh: 我掰了掰手指，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I crack my knuckles and they pop.

lines.zh: 这身皮厚，风都吹不进来。
lines.en: My hide is thick; the wind can't get in.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看太阳，又低下头。
lines.en: I look at the sun, then lower my head.
Who wants a fight? I'll wait.
I lick my teeth; they itch a little.

lines.zh: 站得久了，肚子也叫起来。
lines.en: Standing long enough, my stomach growls.
I am counting the distant mountains.

lines.zh: 我这体格，站着就够吓人。
lines.en: With this build, standing alone is threatening.
The wind blows sand to my feet.
Don't think I'm spacing out; I'm listening.

lines.zh: 我揉了揉肩膀，旧伤还在。
lines.en: I rub my shoulder; the old ache remains.
The savanna is quiet; good for resting.

lines.zh: 我在等一个像样的对手。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a worthy opponent.
Standing that close takes nerve.

lines.zh: 我俯下身，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I bend down and look you over.
Little one, have you trained?
There's not much meat on you.

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛，专挑软的地方看。
lines.en: My eyes are looking for the soft spots.
Either leave, or fight.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，牙全露出来。
lines.en: I grin, and all my teeth show.

lines.zh: 你的拳头在我面前很小。
lines.en: Your fist looks tiny before me.

lines.zh: 大脑袋歪着，像在琢磨你。
lines.en: My big head tilts, sizing you up.

lines.zh: 就你这身高，也敢来草原？
lines.en: At your height, you come to the savanna?
I have your scent now.

lines.zh: 你用不着害怕，先用不着。
lines.en: You needn't be afraid — not yet.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡住太阳，看你更清楚。
lines.en: I raise a hand to block the sun and see you better.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，藏什么呢？
lines.en: What are you hiding in your hands?

lines.zh: 尾巴一卷，挡住身后的空。
lines.en: My tail curls, guarding the space behind.
I'm looking for fear on your face.
You're still standing; that counts for something.
I stare at you, and keep staring.
A blow to my ribs, dull and heavy.

lines.zh: 脖子上的旧伤又裂开了。
lines.en: The old wound on my neck splits again.
My thick hide holds; I only grunt.

lines.zh: 草原上的恐龙尾，我吃得惯。
lines.en: Savanna dinosaur tail suits my taste.
My hide is thick, but not iron.
Big as I am, I retreat slowly.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
I'll remember that punch.
It hurts, but I'm still standing.
The blow only leaves a white mark on my thick hide.

lines.zh: 那股肉味，直往我鼻子里钻。
lines.en: That meat smell bores straight into my nose.
Hand it over; I'm hungry.
My stomach answered first.
Don't be stingy; one bite finishes it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过去，不为别的。
lines.en: I walk over slowly, for nothing else.
It smells better than it looks.
My hand is out; you'd better give it.
This meal, consider it your treat.
Meat scent drifts over, my stomach growls.

lines.zh: 有点肉味，我就挪不动脚。
lines.en: A hint of meat and my feet won't move.

lines.zh: 撞我，你像撞在一堵墙上。
lines.en: Bump me and you've hit a wall.
With this frame, I don't yield.
You bounced back, didn't you?
My bulk drops low and holds steady.
One shift of my body and you're pushed aside.
No one on the ground can shove me.

lines.zh: 厚脚掌碾过地面的碎石。
lines.en: My broad foot grinds the gravel.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挡，你就退了两步。
lines.en: I raise an arm to block and you stagger back.

lines.zh: 碰撞在我这儿，是开打的信号。
lines.en: Bumping me is the signal to fight.
You're too light to make a sound.
She is a warrior of this clan too.

lines.zh: 两条粗尾巴慢慢靠在一起。
lines.en: Our thick tails slowly come together.
With my build, I must move gently.
She laughs, and her teeth are whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 草原够大，能养一窝小的。
lines.en: The savanna is big enough for a brood.

lines.zh: 我把最好的猎物推给她。
lines.en: I push the best catch toward her.

lines.zh: 两个大块头挤在一起，很暖。
lines.en: Two big bodies pressed together are warm.

lines.zh: 这种时候，我把拳头收起来。
lines.en: At a time like this, I put my fists away.
Our footprints sink equally deep.

lines.zh: 日落了，我们慢慢往回走。
lines.en: The sun sets; we walk back slowly.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起来，有点费劲。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up; it takes effort.
I scoop it up and stuff it away.
I weighed it — this one's heavy.

lines.zh: 地上掉的，谁先拿是谁的。
lines.en: Whatever drops belongs to whoever grabs it first.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿能吃吗？我掰一块试试。
lines.en: Is this edible? Let me break off a piece.
I sniff the meat first.

lines.zh: 我这两根手指，比你的手腕粗。
lines.en: These two fingers are thicker than your wrist.
Finding something good improves my mood.
I'll keep it; it may be useful later.

lines.zh: 我把它扔进嘴里嚼了嚼。
lines.en: I toss it in my mouth and chew.
I raise my tail and slam it down.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，别假装没看见。
lines.en: I've got my eye on you; don't pretend otherwise.
The target is too close; running won't help.
I clench my fists; the choice is made.

lines.zh: 你在我面前晃，我就选你。
lines.en: You sway before me, so I choose you.
That prey is mine.
I lower my weight, ready to charge.
I've waited long for this fight.
I've seen you; no slipping away.
I grunt, and it's locked.
My shoulder drops and I bear down on you.
I pick the strongest one.
Target noted; it can't escape.
I single you out from the crowd.
A good opponent; thanks in advance.

lines.zh: 地面震了一下，我起步了。
lines.en: The ground shakes as I start moving.

lines.zh: 一步一步压过去，别抬头。
lines.en: Step by step I press in — don't look up.

lines.zh: 我这尾巴，长在草原上够用。
lines.en: On the savanna this tail is enough.
The distance is shrinking.

lines.zh: 我这口牙，咬断过比翼龙更硬的东西。
lines.en: These teeth have bitten through worse than a pterodactyl.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听出来。
lines.en: Your breathing is off; I can tell.
I raise my fists to my chest.

lines.zh: 我这副大块头，翅膀没用。
lines.en: With a build like this, wings would be useless.
No rush; I take hits better than you.

lines.zh: 粗尾巴在身后扫来扫去。
lines.en: My thick tail sweeps back and forth.

lines.zh: 这一步踩下去，地面会响。
lines.en: When I plant this step, the ground will ring.
You're getting closer to the cliff wall.
I'm calculating when you'll strike.

lines.zh: 还想跑？草原上没有掩体。
lines.en: Still trying to run? There's no cover on the savanna.

lines.zh: 我的影子把太阳挡住了。
lines.en: My shadow blocks the sun for you.

lines.zh: 我这大个子，飞起来不灵。
lines.en: Big as I am, I'm clumsy in the air.
I adjust my stance.
Your breathing is loud.
Good, the last step.

lines.zh: 一拳砸下去，土都翻起来。
lines.en: One punch lands and the earth turns up.
My fist doesn't argue.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，甩出去。
lines.en: I grab your collar and hurl you.
That one should rattle your ribs.

lines.zh: 我用整个身子的重量压过去。
lines.en: I drive my whole weight into it.
The blow sends you back three paces.
My arm is thicker than your leg.
I kick, and sand and stone fly.
Don't block it; you won't hold.
Teeth gritted, I push forward.
I held back a little on this punch.
My fist swings at your shoulder with a gust.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腿，往地上砸。
lines.en: I grab your leg and slam you down.
The sound is dull and solid.
I shake my hand; it tingles.
Again; I'm still standing.
I come out from behind the grassy slope.
The ground shuddered first.
Giran is here.

lines.zh: 这片草原，我来活动活动。
lines.en: I'll stretch my legs on this savanna.

lines.zh: 我的影子长得能盖住两个人。
lines.en: My shadow is long enough to cover two people.
Who's bossing things around here?

lines.zh: 我从恶地一路走来，鞋底都磨平。
lines.en: I walked in from the badlands; my soles are worn.

lines.zh: 站稳了，别被我的脚步晃倒。
lines.en: Steady yourself; don't fall from my footsteps.

lines.zh: 我这身肌肉，不是摆着看的。
lines.en: This muscle isn't for show.
I heard there's someone worth fighting nearby?
I plant myself at the foot of the mountain.
Let me loosen up first.
Even looking up, you can't take all of me in.
I'm here; the savanna is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 好久没遇到像样的对手。
lines.en: It's been long since a decent opponent.

lines.zh: 踩碎枯草，从坡上走下来。
lines.en: I crunch dry grass, coming down the slope.

lines.zh: 从今天起，别在我面前嚣张。
lines.en: From today, don't strut in front of me.

lines.zh: 风把尘土吹起来，我到了。
lines.en: The wind lifts the dust; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 火苗燎过我的皮，焦味很冲。
lines.en: Flames sear my hide, and the stench is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从山脊滚下来，浑身都是土。
lines.en: I tumble down the ridge and land covered in dirt.

lines.zh: 水没到我的下巴，我呛了一大口。
lines.en: Water reaches my chin and I swallow a mouthful.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来，又砸回地上。
lines.en: The blast lifts me up and slams me back down.
The arrow sticks in my thick hide like a thorn.

lines.zh: 那股怪劲钻进我骨头里，酸得难受。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into my bones and it aches.

lines.zh: 饿到手脚发软，拳头都握不紧。
lines.en: Hunger makes my limbs weak and my fists loose.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，头发都立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拖，体重也没用。
lines.en: The void pulls me down; my weight is useless.
